sources.mark: Google's signin-assets.zip, the G cut out of the 4x icon-only button PNGs of the light and the dark theme, its pixels untouched and each on its theme's fill. PNGs because the G in the SVG files is drawn with blur filters and an HTML gradient, which the SVG renderers on iOS and Android do not draw. https://developers.google.com/static/identity/images/signin-assets.zip, read 2026-11-14
